row.notes: Per-slice populate for Career_Build_RnDPieOverview (also called from the 0x141f4a760 callback). Loops k_Career_UpgradeDeptCodeTable; code guard cmp r14d,3/ja @0x141f48218, slot index cap cmp r13d,4/ja @0x141f4821e (already permits 5), 4-entry jump table (bound cmp r14d,3 @0x141f4822b, table @0x141f48231, default = error_department/white). Colours are an INLINE switch (aero 0xffeead00 @0x141f4858e, chassis 0xff3ec58d, maintenance 0xff16deff, engine 0xff7a2aed). Names lng_rnd_dept_%s / _overview_description from the matched icon name. Slot = [this+0x670] + 0x80 + idx*0x220 (@0x141f48327); builds a temp with Career_Build_RnDPieSlot @0x141f484bd, move-assigns it in with Career_MoveAssign_RnDPieSlot @0x141f484c8, destroys the temp @0x141f484d0. Sector VM nodes by name-hash under rnd_wheel_icon (empty handle on a miss); highlight clamp 3 < g_Career_RnDOverviewSelectedDept. A 5th slot must be CONSTRUCTED after Career_Construct_RnDPieObject and destroyed on every destroy path before the guard is relaxed: relaxing the guard over an unconstructed slot faults in Vm_MoveAssign_NodeHandle at career load (rnd_ui.md#pie-object).
